visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a vibrant blue puffer jacket, pink trousers, and a black face mask stands on an urban street at night. He holds a stack of lottery scratch cards and a smartphone, gesturing energetically toward the camera. The background features dimly lit buildings, a few parked motorbikes, and passing cars under artificial streetlights. (2) The man walks into a Taiwan Lottery shop. The setting shifts to a brightly lit retail interior with yellow and red signage. He approaches a counter where a male clerk in a grey shirt is working. Behind the clerk are various lottery posters and a screen showing lottery results. (3) The character interacts with the clerk, placing a large stack of winning scratch cards on the counter. He uses his smartphone to record the transaction. The camera captures close-up shots of the clerk counting a thick stack of cash and then the main character buying two new specific lottery tickets. (4) The character waits inside the shop, looking up at a monitor on the wall while holding the new tickets. His eyes show anticipation. The screen displays numbers and lottery logos. (5) The screen changes to show the results of the draw. The character looks at the screen and then back at the camera with a disappointed expression, rubbing his neck. (6) The video cuts to a black screen with white text indicating the final financial result of the test.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male vocal starts with an energetic greeting and fast-paced narration. Upbeat electronic background music with a prominent 4/4 beat begins. Low-level urban traffic noise is audible in the background. (2) Vocal tone remains constant as the speaker moves. Subtle plastic rustling sounds are heard as scratch cards are handled. The music maintains its steady tempo. (3) The environment shifts to indoor acoustics. A digital chime sounds (Taiwan Lottery terminal). The clerk's voice is heard briefly in a neutral, professional tone. Sounds of bills being counted and papers being moved are clearly audible. (4) Short duration digital UI beeps are heard from the lottery system. The main speaker reacts with shorter, more breathless vocal inflections indicating tension. (5) A sharp digital 'Ding' sound accompanies the result display. The speaker's voice drops in valence, sounding dejected and sarcastic. (6) The video concludes with a loud canned laugh track (laugh track SFX) and the music fading out abruptly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Practical Test -> Failure Result
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To debunk 'get rich quick' lottery strategies circulated on social media by performing a real-life test and showing the resulting financial loss.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video results in a loss of money and criticizes the strategy, making it unlikely to be a brand endorsement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical short-form video editing tropes, including high-energy narration, jump cuts, and canned laugh tracks to maintain viewer engagement.
